stages.name: Letters and first words
stages.blurb: One letter at a time, and the first words you can sound out.

stages.blurb: Two letters that make one sound, and words that start or end with two sounds.

stages.name: Vowel teams and tricky spellings
stages.blurb: Vowels that work in pairs, and the words English spells oddly.

stages.name: On to real books
stages.blurb: The last common words and endings, then real books.
